annotations.title: Livability scores by mesh block (by suburb)

description:
All seven livability dimensions — affluence, lifestyle, hip,
convenience, family, safety, tranquility — scored 0-100 for every
mesh block in the suburb, each with its human band. Averaging
a dimension across the mesh blocks reproduces the suburb figure at
``/lifestyle/livability``. Values only; polygons come from
``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
